summary_en: Life Corporation completed a tender offer for all outstanding shares of ALBIS Co., Ltd. at 3,650 yen per share, acquiring 100% of the company and delisting it from the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
title_en: Notice of Results of Public Tender Offer for Shares of ALBIS Co., Ltd. by Life Corporation and Notice of Changes in Parent Company, Major Shareholders and Principal Shareholder
translation_en_brief: Life Corporation completed a public tender offer for all outstanding shares of ALBIS Co., Ltd. at a fixed price of 3,650 yen per share. The tender offer resulted in Life Corporation acquiring 100% ownership of ALBIS, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary. Following the acquisition, ALBIS was delisted from the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Life Corporation became the parent company and principal shareholder of ALBIS as a result of this transaction.
